scientific_integrity: Finite exact-rational tests corroborate, but do not replace, the all-n proof; formulas and extremal witnesses are explicit. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only at two boundary evaluations for bounded nondecreasing real inputs on one-dimensional equal-cell partitions. No claim for interior evaluation, nonuniform grids, or unrestricted inputs. A potentially relevant Oswald 2013 chapter was only accessible in abstract.
title: Sharp monotone endpoint range defect of uniform linear-spline orthogonal projection
